packs.name: Havenwild Worldgen Compositor
packs.notes: Semantic terrain compositor source pack covering base materials, corner/cardinal masks, shore-band masks, detail overlays, profile previews, schemas, and compositor pseudocode. Best used as the design/source baseline for any future runtime terrain compositor rather than direct drop-in runtime content.

packs.name: Havenwild Macro Worldgen
packs.notes: Large-scale world-layout source pack that defines landmass, climate, hydrology, biome, and shore-profile semantic maps for a mainland-plus-islands world. It is a planning/input layer for future worldgen work, not a runtime scene pack.
